snippet.title: Assassin's Creed III Remastered | Announce trailer | PS4
snippet.description: Relive the American Revolution or experience it for the first time in Assassin's Creed III Remastered, with enhanced graphics and improved gameplay mechanics. Also includes Assassin's Creed Liberation remastered and all solo DLC content. Available on 29/03/19!
